why.source: TextOS, reached through its API only (AGENTS.md). The command reads the API's address and token from TEXTOS_API_BASE_URL and TEXTOS_API_TOKEN.
why.siteId: The id TextOS addresses this site by: a release names it as its destination, and the approved action targets it. A release addressed to any other site is refused.
why.workspaceId: No TextOS workspace is assigned to ShortsOS yet (docs/api-gaps.md). Until the owner records one here, the intake refuses to run and the build refuses any received release.
why.release: The capability and the contract ShortsOS asks TextOS for. The API does not serve them yet: a release to a Git-published site is a demand on the API (docs/api-gaps.md).
why.locales: The site publishes in English (en-US). fr-FR is added here when the French pages ship; until then a French release is refused rather than published where it does not belong.
why.contentDocumentFingerprint: The ContentDocument@1 schema this site renders against. A release validated against any other schema is refused.
why.acceptedEngineShas: The API's engine changes with each TextOS deployment. Every release records the engine SHA it ran on (evidence.json, intake.json). Replace "any" with a list of SHAs to accept only engines that were reviewed.
why.releasesDir: A received release lands in content/releases/textos/<slug>/.
